ModMetaData.name: Regions and Societies: Vanilla Factions Expanded Patch
ModMetaData.author: Regions and Societies Team
ModMetaData.description:
Compatibility patch: world objects from the Vanilla Factions Expanded family are classified under Regions and Societies territory rules.
One typed check covers the whole family: every VFE moving base (VFE Core's MovingBase and its subclasses, including VFE Medieval 2's Merchant Guild) is recognised as a caravan rather than a territorial holding. The other VFE faction modules ship no world objects of their own — their faction bases are vanilla settlements, already governed. Requires Regions and Societies and the Vanilla Expanded Framework.
